newsitem.title: USA: Premier Parks fy 96 shr profit $0.13.
newsitem.headline: Premier Parks fy 96 shr profit $0.13.

text.p: Income before income taxes and extraordinary

While these results exclude the operating results of the parks acquired in the fourth quarter of 1996, they include the impact of the interest expense incurred on borrowings made to finance those acquisitions and associated depreciation and amortization expense.

The increase in revenue (16.9%), income from operations (67.2%), net income (219.1%) and EBITDA (37.7%) from the six parks owned for the full 1996 season as compared to the actual results for those parks for 1995 resulted from a 10.5% aggregate attendance increase, an aggregate increase of 5.9% in total revenue per capita, and increased operating efficiencies and economies of scale generating an improved EBITDA margin.

"We are pleased with the results achieved at the parks," noted Kieran E. Burke, chairman and chief executive officer of the company. "We are most pleased with the improvement in the three parks we acquired in August 1995, which in our first year of ownership recorded gains in attendance, revenue and EBITDA of 16%, 25% and 51% respectively," Burke added. Actual results as reported for financial statement accounting purposes include the operating costs associated with the parks acquired in the fourth quarter of 1996 (Elitch Gardens in Denver, Colo., The Great Escape in Lake George, N.Y. and the two Waterworld properties in Northern California). Burke commented that the company's capital improvement and marketing plans for all its parks, including the parks acquired in 1996, Riverside Park in Springfield, Mass. (acquired in Feb. 1997) and Marine World Africa USA in Vallejo, Calif. (to be managed by a subsidiary of the company commencing April 1997), are moving forward on schedule.

Premier is a leading theme park company that operates 12 regional parks (11 of which are owned) in nine geographically diverse markets. The 12 parks had aggregate 1996 attendance of approximately 8.3 million.
